title: Chapter 72: Two-Star Scenario!
html:
“You’re looking for heaven inside the well?” The boy’s answer sparked a sudden realization. Chen Ge’s emotions surged, and he turned away to steady himself with a deep breath. Thankfully, the woman did not notice his reaction.

When he turned back, he found the boy staring at something behind him, the same light in his eyes that had appeared when he saw Xu Wan in Mortician’s Makeup.

“Fan Yu, it’s time to go home,” the woman repeated. At last, the boy moved away from the well. His head remained bowed, but his mood had visibly improved.

Once they left the Haunted House and stepped into the sunlight, the boy reverted to his former self, silent and haunted by naked fear. Whether he feared the light or the living people around him was impossible to tell.

The woman thanked Chen Ge and led the boy away. Once they left New Century Park, Chen Ge exhaled in relief. The black phone vibrated in his pocket, but he remained on the steps, reviewing what had happened.

Looking for heaven inside the well… Perhaps Fan Yu had meant it literally. His aunt had told him that his missing parents had gone to a place called heaven, hoping to soften the loss.

She had probably expected him to understand the truth as he grew older, but the trauma had arrested his development. What disturbed Chen Ge most was the answer Fan Yu gave beside the well.

His parents had gone to heaven, and he kept searching for heaven in a well. Did that not suggest he had watched someone throw his parents into one?

Their bodies are in the well!Without realizing it, Chen Ge lit a cigarette. Rather than call the police immediately, he continued reasoning through the possibility.

Both of Fan Yu’s parents taught at Mu Yang High School, and one of the black phone’s side missions concerns both the school and a well. If that isn’t a coincidence, their disappearance must be connected to the school.

Chen Ge took out the black phone, and there was an unread message. He opened it.

“Different choices lead to different outcomes. Your first special visitor has departed. You made the correct choice during the visit. Congratulations, you have earned a reward! Hidden Trial Mission unlocked—Mu Yang High School! This is a side mission for the four-star scenario School of the Afterlife. Completing it will unlock the two-star scenario Mu Yang High School and reduce the difficulty of School of the Afterlife’s Trial Mission.

“Mu Yang High School Trial Mission (Scream Factor: 2 Stars): This scenario contains four side missions. Experience them all and survive to unlock the scenario.

“Mission Venue: Mu Yang High School.

“Mission Requirement: Reach the mission venue before 11:00 p.m. tonight and survive until dawn.

“Mission Hint: Everyone carries a deep well in their heart, where shameful and unknowable secrets lie buried.

“Do you wish to accept the mission?

“Warning: This Trial Mission remains available for only twenty-four hours. If you do not accept it within that time, the mission will be forfeited and the scenario permanently locked.”

The message rattled Chen Ge. He had not expected his reward for receiving a special visitor to be a two-star Trial Mission. He already knew how terrifying such missions could be. The one-star Ping An Apartments Trial Mission had proved far more dangerous than any Nightmare Mission.

Chen Ge reread the information until he had memorized every detail.

The previous mission required me to find the murderer while this mission only requires me to stay alive until dawn. It looks simpler in comparison, but the black phone must have its reasons to label this a two-star mission; its level of danger has to be higher than Murder by Midnight’s Trial Mission!

Survive. The requirement sounded simple, which only made it more unsettling. The twenty-four-hour deadline left Chen Ge torn. He did not know whether forfeiting this mission would hinder the four-star School of the Afterlife scenario.

Unlocking a four-star scenario was practically impossible for him now, but surrendering the opportunity still hurt.

Forfeiting this might also cost me School of the Afterlife. Losing two scenarios at once is too much.Chen Ge weighed the risks and rewards.If I refuse, I lose both scenarios. If I succeed, I unlock a two-star scenario and complete one of School of the Afterlife’s side missions. The Haunted House needs fresh attractions to keep visitors coming back. This opportunity arrived at exactly the right time. I should try.

With New Century Park facing closure, he needed dramatic results within three months—something the current Haunted House could never deliver. After a moment’s thought, he accepted the mission.

After the message disappeared, Chen Ge decided not to waste any more time. He called Xu Wan to inform her to look after the Haunted House for the rest of the day because he had to go somewhere else.

Fan Yu had triggered the Mu Yang High School Trial Mission, and Chen Ge believed the boy could provide more information. He raced out of the park just in time to see Fan Yu and his aunt board a bus.

Route 14.

Chen Ge hailed a cab and told the driver, “Go to the next stop for Route 14.”

The taxi reached the next stop a minute before the bus. When it arrived, the crowded aisle forced the woman and boy toward the rear. Neither noticed Chen Ge board.

Following them home might nab me some surprise discoveries.

Rather than reveal himself, Chen Ge remained near the front. Over the next seven stops, passengers steadily disembarked while the neighborhoods outside grew increasingly desolate.

When they almost reached the final station, the woman and the boy finally got off. They did not walk down the street but turned down a small, secluded path.

They live at such a secluded place? Then again, the woman did mention finding many doctors for the boy—that would burn a hole in the family finances.

Chen Ge trailed behind them. A short distance later, the woman and the boy suddenly increased in pace.

Have I been discovered? Or are they hiding from something else?
